_comment: Per-chart narratives. CI (build_prompt.py -> GitHub Models -> write_narrative.py) overwrites these from live numbers; this committed copy is the fallback so the page always reads well. source = 'fallback' | 'github-models'.

notes.basket: The breakfast basket, an index averaging prices of coffee, sugar, wheat, and orange juice and benchmarked to 2015 as 100, currently stands at 132, indicating a 32% increase since 2015. This rise reflects a recent and uneven climb in soft commodity prices. The basket aggregates global commodity prices to provide a general sense of cost movement for typical breakfast items. The overall index conceals significant variation among its components.
notes.movers: Coffee has driven the majority of the increase with a 93% rise since 2015, followed by orange juice at 22%. Wheat and sugar have seen only modest gains of 7% and 5%, respectively. These price changes originate primarily from weather events and crop diseases—such as citrus greening affecting orange juice and frost or drought impacting arabica coffee. Soft commodity markets are typically thin and more susceptible to abrupt price shifts from such supply disruptions rather than broad inflationary forces.
notes.why: The headline rise in the breakfast basket is largely attributable to a handful of weather-exposed crops. Given the nature of these agricultural inputs, elevated price levels can persist for several years depending on ongoing climatic and plant health conditions. Market thinness amplifies the price impact of these supply factors.
